creator_type: professional (attachment-based infant and toddler sleep consultant, per caption), author of the book's parent tips
product: Personalised bedtime picture book 'המסע של [child's name] ביער החלומות' (hardcover, printed at a Israeli printing house per caption), made with MeBook (@mebook.ai); child's name and photos appear in it
disclosure_visible: caption: 'הספר בשיתוף @mebook.ai מיזם כחול לבן'; also 'אחד משיתופי הפעולה המרגשים עבורי'; paid-partnership label 0 in media info
format: talking-head to camera sitting on the floor holding the book, burned-in word-by-word subtitles, flip-through demo and a short B-roll of a toddler with the book

hook_0_3s.opening_image: Woman with glasses sitting cross-legged on the floor, resting her chin on a hand, holding a colourful book cover with a cartoon boy in a glowing forest
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.2-3.7 s (machine transcript): 'אני עדיין לא מאמינה שאני אומרת את זה, אבל כתבתי ספר.'
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: 'עדיין לא מאמינה שאני אומרת את זה' then 'ספר' (word-chunk subtitles)
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: a personal surprise announcement ('I wrote a book') plus the colourful book held toward the lens.

shots.subject: Creator on the floor holding the book front cover, then the back cover with a child's photo in a circle and the MeBook logo
shots.purpose: Introduce herself as author and show the personal back cover

shots.subject: Transition effect then a hand turning the first page, with the parent letter page
A toddler with a bowl haircut in a green sweater looking at the open book
shots.purpose: Child reaction/use as the line about connection between the attachment figure and the child

shots.subject: Creator flips through the book pages showing illustrations and parent-tip text, and the final tips page with sample illustration choices
shots.purpose: Show interior and the tips on every page; explain personalisation

shots.subject: Creator holds the cover again, pointing to it; subtitle 'ביער החלומות כל הפרטים בתיאור'

how_value_is_shown: Creator's own words about a bedtime activity connecting parent and child, tips on every page, plus personal photo and name; the pages are flipped on camera
demonstration: Flipping the pages and pointing at the back cover and the tips; a short shot of a toddler with the book
proof: Physical book shown; toddler B-roll of reading; no before/after
emotion: Pride and excitement of a first book; calm tone
personal_story: Creator announces her first book written as a sleep consultant (caption: 'הספר הראשון שלי!')
selling_language: 'זה לא סתם ספר' (machine transcript); 'עם התמונות של הילד שלכם והשם של הילד שלכם' (machine transcript); caption: 'מתנה מושלמת ומיוחדת עבור הקטנטנים שלכם'
captions_on_screen: burned-in subtitles of speech, bold white sans-serif with outline, one to four words at a time, centre
editing_rhythm: 5 shots over 37 s, average about 7 s; long static takes with subtitle pacing; one transition effect at 10 s
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s show the cover and subtitle 'כל הפרטים בתיאור'. Caption: link to purchase in bio; comment 'מסע' to get a DM link; code dyadana for a small discount
price_or_code: caption: discount code dyadana; no price anywhere
convincing: Interpretation: a professional with a personal angle, the explanation of why a bedtime ritual matters, and a real physical book flipped on camera; the single-word comment trigger is easy.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the claim and purpose get long before the CTA; the low-angle webcam-like framing is plain; the likeness of illustration to the child is not shown side by side.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a talking head holding the book with word-by-word subtitles and a one-word comment trigger is easy to reproduce solo. Expert-authored bedtime or developmental framing may be a stronger hook than a gift story.
solo_without_child: yes: the creator only talks and flips the book; one optional toddler B-roll shot
not_verified: Real price; whether the toddler B-roll is the creator's child; music; whether the photo on the back cover matches the cover character (not shown side by side).
